title: Battle of Guinea
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Guinea", at revision 1370442279, opens: "The Battle of Guinea took place on the Gulf of Guinea, in West Africa, 1478, between a Portuguese fleet and a Castilian fleet in the context of the War of the Castilian Succession." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3772937, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1478 battle between a Portuguese fleet and a Castilian fleet in the context of the War of the Castilian Succession". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
